scientific_summary: For a closed binomial repeated-count model with an arbitrary count-valued abundance law of finite second moment, two visits identify both visit-specific detection probabilities by a moment cancellation and then identify the entire abundance law through its probability-generating function. One visit is globally nonidentifying.
limitations: The equal-detection moment formula is already present for mixed-Poisson N-mixtures in Dennis et al. (2015) and is not claimed as new. The new claim concerns arbitrary abundance laws, visit-specific detection, full-law identification, and the sharp one-versus-two visit boundary. Strong observation-model assumptions and residual originality risk remain.
